title: A Compass for the Provision
author: Dominic Okonkwo
blurb: Yara Montrose, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
